name: Bask
author: Erin Carter
description: A high-key warm color field — big soft blobs of peach, gold and coral drift over one another while a low dawn glow lifts from the bottom third like light through morning haze. Airy, bright, grainy; the antidote to dark backgrounds.

params.label: Drift speed
params.effect: How fast the soft blobs drift across one another; 0 holds the field nearly still.

params.label: Blob size
params.effect: Size of the colour blobs; high gives two or three huge banks, low breaks into smaller clouds.

params.label: Dawn glow
params.effect: Strength of the warm glow rising from the lower third; 0 evens the field out.

params.label: Folding
params.effect: Gentle domain-warp on the banks; low keeps them broad and clean, high adds soft folds.

params.label: Mouse influence
params.effect: How strongly the pointer pulls the field toward it; 0 ignores the mouse.
